label: BRAF V600E

selector.definition: This exact nucleotide substitution on the stated transcript.

comment.text: BRAF p.Val600Glu (V600E) is an activating kinase-domain substitution associated with MAPK pathway signaling in melanoma. This example describes its biological context; any clinical interpretation requires the patient’s tumor classification and current disease-specific evidence.

applicability_notes: Applies to the specified V600E substitution in melanoma.
Do not extend this comment to non-V600 variants, BRAF fusions, or a different tumor type.
